title: SvgFeDropShadow
responsibility: Renders the native feDropShadow element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeDropShadow.attributes
inputs.description: Native feDropShadow attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeDropShadow.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feDropShadow element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeDropShadow
outputs.description: The actual native feDropShadow element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
